evidence_items.locator: Paragraph 2, quotation attributed to Musk's Nikkei interview

receipt.public_excerpt: Full auto-pilot capability is going to happen, probably, in the five- or six-year time frame.

evidence_items.explanation: Documents a public prediction of full autonomy in 2014. Its horizon was five or six years, so it does not support the stronger claim that Musk promised delivery the following year in every instance.

receipt.public_excerpt: Musk says during the first earnings call of the year he expects full self-driving by the end of 2019.

evidence_items.explanation: The quoted entry records the 2019 prediction. The same chronology documents full-autonomy predictions in 2015, the proposed autonomous cross-country drive in 2016 and 2017, and renewed autonomy predictions in 2018.
